title: Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024
description: Ethiopia's first comprehensive personal data protection law. Establishes data subject rights, controller/processor obligations, breach notification, and designates the Ethiopian Communications Authority (ECA) as supervisory authority. Passed 4 April 2024, gazetted 24 July 2024.

title: Ethiopian Digital Identification Proclamation No. 1284/2023
description: Establishes the nationwide foundational Digital Identification System (Fayda) for residents. Covers registration data, biometric collection, alias numbers, authentication consent, and data security safeguards. Federal Negarit Gazette No. 19, 18 April 2023.

title: Computer Crime Proclamation No. 958/2016
description: Criminalizes computer crimes and establishes digital evidence and investigative procedures. Repeals Articles 706-711 of the Criminal Code and Article 5 of the Telecom Fraud Offence Proclamation 761/2012. Federal Negarit Gazette No. 83, 7 July 2016.

title: Electronic Transactions Proclamation No. 1205/2020
description: Provides legal recognition for electronic messages and transactions, including a consent-based rule that no person may be compelled to use, provide or accept electronic messages. Federal Negarit Gazette No. 57, 30 June 2020.

title: Digital Ethiopia 2025: A Digital Strategy for Ethiopia Inclusive Prosperity
description: National digital transformation strategy covering digital infrastructure, e-government, digital identity, digital finance and digital skills. Publication date not independently verified; verify before use.

title: Constitution of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia (1995)
description: Supreme law of Ethiopia. Article 26 guarantees the right to privacy. Relevant to citizen rights and institutional accountability. Official text URL not yet verified.

title: Fayda National ID (official portal)
publisher_or_author: National ID Program (NIDP), Office of the Prime Minister
description: Official Fayda national digital ID portal. Describes the Fayda number, registration, and services. Fayda established under Proclamation 1284/2023 as a foundational legal ID.

title: World Bank: Digital ID for Inclusion and Services Project (press release)
description: Announces US$350 million World Bank support for Ethiopia's Fayda digital ID rollout, targeting 90 million enrolments. Notes the Digital ID Proclamation passed March 2023 and personal data protection safeguards.

title: End-User Perspectives on Fayda ID from Marginalized and Vulnerable Groups (ID4D)
description: Qualitative study of social risks, inclusion and consent concerns around Fayda digital ID among vulnerable groups in Ethiopia.

title: Digital Trade Country Profile: Ethiopia (UNECA)
publisher_or_author: United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA)
description: Country profile covering Ethiopia's digital regulatory regime, e-transactions, data protection status, internet penetration and e-commerce environment.

title: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)
description: Binding regional treaty on personal data protection, electronic commerce and cybersecurity. Adopted 27 June 2014; entered into force 8 June 2023. Requires State Parties to establish national personal data protection authorities.

title: Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019 (No. 24 of 2019)
description: Kenya's principal data protection law, giving effect to Article 31(c) and (d) of the Constitution of Kenya 2010 and establishing the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC).

title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR)
description: EU-wide framework for the protection of natural persons regarding the processing of personal data and rules on the free movement of personal data. Effective 25 May 2018.

title: Regulation (EU) No 910/2014 (eIDAS)
description: EU regulation on electronic identification and trust services for electronic transactions, enabling cross-border recognition of electronic identification schemes.

title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
description: EU regulation establishing a harmonised framework for artificial intelligence systems, including risk-based obligations affecting public-sector and biometric/identity-related AI use.

title: Principles on Identification for Sustainable Development (ID4D Principles)
description: Global principles for digital identification systems covering inclusion, design, governance, privacy and security. Referenced by Ethiopia's ID4D documentation.
